name: get_user_profile
title: Get user profile
description: Profile snapshot: CEFR level, target/source languages, due card count, weak words, recent lookups. Pass `lang` to scope the snapshot to one learning language (for users learning several); omit it for the user's primary language.

lang.description: Optional ISO or BCP-47 tag (en, en-us, pt-br). Scopes the whole profile - level, due count, weak words - to that learning language. Omit for the user's primary language.
